text: Ònia Perramon That will depend on your university - they will need to give you the necessary papers if you wish to extend your student visa.  Otherwise, you could leave Israel before your visa expires, and then your partner could apply for you to come here under the partner visa process. This is quite standard (and it means you won't have to start living together beforehand). Note that in either case, as an unmarried couple you will probably have a long period where you cannot work
